inv_mov_sign_per_type.name: inv_mov_sign_per_type
inv_mov_sign_per_type.value: (type IN ('receive','transfer_in','return') AND quantity > 0) OR (type IN ('issue','transfer_out') AND quantity < 0) OR (type = 'adjustment' AND quantity <> 0)

items_phi_rei_chemicals_only.name: items_phi_rei_chemicals_only
items_phi_rei_chemicals_only.value: category = 'agrochemical' OR (phi_days IS NULL AND rei_hours IS NULL)

nursery_batches_counts_nonneg.name: nursery_batches_counts_nonneg
nursery_batches_counts_nonneg.value: germinated >= 0 AND ready >= 0 AND transplanted >= 0 AND discarded >= 0

harvests_override_pairing.name: harvests_override_pairing
harvests_override_pairing.value: phi_override = false OR (phi_override_reason IS NOT NULL AND phi_override_by IS NOT NULL)

prod_mov_sign_per_type.name: prod_mov_sign_per_type
prod_mov_sign_per_type.value: (type IN ('harvest_in','transfer_in') AND kg > 0) OR (type IN ('transfer_out','sale','waste') AND kg < 0) OR (type = 'adjustment' AND kg <> 0)

climate_at_least_one_reading.name: climate_at_least_one_reading
climate_at_least_one_reading.value: temperature_c IS NOT NULL OR humidity_pct IS NOT NULL OR ec_ms_cm IS NOT NULL OR ph IS NOT NULL
